title: Cerberus Vault Guardian
description: A massive, multicolored cybernetic wolf-like creature with glowing orange eyes, golden mechanical crown, and braided white mane emerges from a cracked circular metallic vault door. Rainbow paint drips from its snarling jaws onto a dark mound below where a small hooded figure stands with arms raised in awe or reverence.
prompt: A fierce multicolored cyber wolf with braided white mane, glowing orange eyes and golden mechanical crown bursts through a cracked circular metallic vault door.
